title: Great App, but…
body: It really is a very good app. I used it for the first free week. My daughter, who does not have self regulation issues, loved it and it really worked with her. Problem is, within less than a day, my ADHD son got OBSESSED with devices again, after we’d weaned him off. He could not focus on anything else except screen time. We got no schoolwork done because he’d be sulking or crying about it not being Screentime. As parents, stress levels went up because of additional outbursts and arguing about access to devices. Ultimately, with him, who was the “target audience” in us trying Joon, the negatives outweighed the positives.
author: camelotCPT

title: Great!
body: We love the Joon app! I would like to request bonus quests though. Quests that they can choose to do any time of the week if they want more coins. Also more variety in doters? The kids love it!

title: Transparency
body: The app requires membership fees which is not stated until you have downloaded it and answered a bunch of personal questions. Misleading.
